name: ESP32-DevKitC-V4
description: Espressif ESP32-DevKitC V4, 2x19 pins, rows 1.0" apart
source: https://docs.espressif.com/projects/esp-dev-kits/en/latest/esp32/esp32-devkitc/user_guide.html — Header Block tables J2/J3 and pin layout image; row distance 25.40 mm from https://dl.espressif.com/dl/schematics/esp32_devkitc_v4_dimensions.pdf; schematic https://dl.espressif.com/dl/schematics/esp32_devkitc_v4_sch.pdf
notes: VP = GPIO36, VN = GPIO39, RX = GPIO3, TX = GPIO1, EN = CHIP_PU. CLK, D0-D3 and CMD (GPIO6-11) belong to the SPI flash — do not use them. IO16/IO17 are free only with WROOM/SOLO-1 modules. At 1.0" between its rows the board leaves just one free row on one side of a standard breadboard; many people put it across two boards.
